newsitem.title: USA: FPC Fla. nuke seen reduced through the week.
newsitem.headline: FPC Fla. nuke seen reduced through the week.

text.p: Florida Power Corp's (FPC) 825 megawatt Crystal River nuclear power unit 3 was expected to operate at near 84 percent of capacity through the week for scheduled water pump maintenance, a company spokeswoman said.
"We don't expect to go any lower (than 85 percent), we should be at 100 percent later this week, perhaps Thursday or Friday," spokeswoman Melanie Forbrick said Monday.
The unit, located at Red Level, Fla. reduced power as scheduled early Monday for the maintenance, Forbrick said.
Florida Power is a subsidiary of Florida Progress Corp.
